result.question: What happened when Gaal fought Abimelech?

readings.answer: Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him.
readings.support: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him.

readings.answer: Many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.
